      "band": "P2",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Directly advances the kernel project's core goal of decoupling validation from node-specific callbacks. As the author notes, validation functions handling failures via 'AbortNode and triggering shutdowns... makes error handling in libbitcoinkernel application code difficult.'"
    },

    },
    {

    },
    {

    },

      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter RPC interfaces, behavior, or data returned to external users."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Updates to unit tests, benchmarks, and fuzz harnesses follow the validation signature modifications.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not modify core test frameworks, runners, or test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Expands 'src/util/result.h' (+394/-62) with failure types and InfoType extensions, backed by 'src/test/result_tests.cpp'.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Substantially upgrades the generic 'util::Result' utility to support failure types and structured error data across subsystems. While internally focused, it extends a shared utility pattern used across multiple modules."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Significantly alters function signatures across 'src/validation.cpp' (+368/-193) and 'src/node/blockstorage.cpp' (+119/-67) to return 'util::Result' and 'FlushResult' annotated with '[[nodiscard]]'.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Refactors error propagation in block connection, chain activation, and state flushing without changing consensus rules or validation invariants. It enforces caller error handling via '[[nodiscard]]', but its impetus and primary value lie in kernel modularity."
    },
